allReviewedPassages.rawText: The reducer now collects failing source trees only from validated live records linked by observed/runBaseline/taskBase/verification associations for this failure's exact command/configuration. After reducing the complete retained history, it checks every otherwise supported passing verification against these linked failures. A conflicting active verification leaves the owner intact and the obligation open, and records a contradiction gap naming the immutable source tree and verification dispatch. Earlier contradictory attempts remain gaps even after a different supported fixed source verifies the repair. Later associated failure evidence can also reopen a conflicting earlier verification. No automatic repeat-measurement reconciliation was added.

allReviewedPassages.rawText:
The initial correction passed 1979/0. Self-review then added history-order coverage. Command `node tests/super-code/replay-harness.mjs > evidence-task7-fix-order-red.log 2>&1` exited 1 with:

```text
[FAIL] supported different-source repair retains earlier verification contradiction in history
1980 passed, 1 failed
```

That RED showed the first correction checked only the latest verification and could drop an earlier contradiction gap when a genuinely different fixed source passed. The final correction checks every retained verification and only reopens the currently active conflicting one.
